articles.summary: At Discover, our third-party risk program ran outside procurement, so requesters never knew when to loop risk in. Why TPRM belongs inside the purchase workflow.
articles.title: Third-party risk belongs inside the purchase workflow

articles.summary: Learn what third-party risk management (TPRM) is, how its seven stages work, and how procurement can catch supplier risk before a purchase begins.
articles.title: What is third-party risk management (TPRM)?
